subject: Retention schedule alignment for Medipath
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@medipath.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medipath.com
Date: 2028-07-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Retention schedule alignment for Medipath

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security team asked me to confirm a few specifics on retention and purge timing before we move forward with procurement:

- Can Redwood provide a defined backup purge window (we prefer a scheduled multi-day window per month) and a firm SLA for restore availability during that window?
- We need separation between telemetry logs (product/usage) and audit/security logs — different retention rules will apply.
- For incident/forensic holds, do you have a documented escalation and hold-release process? What is the maximum hold extension you can support without escalation to legal?
- Are backups encrypted with customer-managed keys (CMKs) or Redwood-managed keys?

I've attached a short requirements PDF outlining our ask. Procurement is targeting a go-live by mid-August, so any timelines for the backup purge and DPA amendments would be helpful.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Sr. InfoSec Manager
Medipath Health

Attachment: Medipath-retention-ask.pdf (PDF)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@medipath.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention schedule alignment for Medipath

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear asks. Quoting your questions below and adding our proposals.

On Mon, Jul 1, 2028 at 10:12 AM Sarah Nguyen <sarah@medipath.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the demo last week. Our security team asked me to confirm a few specifics on retention and purge timing before we move forward with procurement:
> ...

Proposals from Redwood:
- Backup purge window: we recommend a monthly staggered purge over a 3-day rolling window to minimize restore impact. For your preferred mid-August go-live, we can schedule the first purge for Aug 15-17, 2028; subsequent purges will fall on the 15th–17th of each month unless you request a different cadence.
- Restore availability SLA: during scheduled purge windows we guarantee snapshot restore start within 4 hours for Dedicated or Private customers under contract; hosted customers have a 12-hour target during purge windows.
- Logs: we can separate telemetry (6 months) and audit/security logs (13 months) by default. Audit log extension to 18 months is available for enterprise customers with a committed usage plan — we can add that as a contractual option.
- Forensic holds: standard hold process is documented; temporary holds are supported up to 120 days administratively. Longer holds (120–180 days) require a DPA addendum and Legal sign-off.
- Keys: by default backups are encrypted with Redwood-managed keys; CMK support (customer-managed KMS) is available on Private deployments and on Dedicated with an add-on.

I've attached a proposed retention schedule (retention_schedule_v2.xlsx) and a draft DPA addendum template (we'll share Word/Docx on request). Could Kimberly and Marissa confirm technical feasibility on the log partitioning and snapshot encryption?

Next steps I propose:
1) Kimberly to confirm technical details and provide any constraints.
2) Marissa to coordinate DPA addendum draft and procurement timing.
3) Schedule 30-minute alignment call this week to lock dates.

Thanks — I'll wait for Kimberly/Marissa's confirmation and then propose calendar times.

— Logan
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: retention_schedule_v2.xlsx (Excel)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T13:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention schedule alignment for Medipath (technical)

Logan/Marissa — quick technical notes to confirm what I can deliver and a few constraints.

Quoted:
> - Logs: we can separate telemetry (6 months) and audit/security logs (13 months) by default. Audit log extension to 18 months is available for enterprise customers with a committed usage plan — we can add that as a contractual option.

We can enforce separate retention at the ingestion path: telemetry -> blob store with 180d TTL; audit/security -> WORM timeline with 395d TTL. Implementation details:
- Telemetry: 6 months (180 days), rolling TTL, no special restore guarantees beyond standard backups.
- Audit/security: 13 months (395 days) by default. We can support 18 months (547 days) if the customer signs the addendum and accepts the unit-cost uplift (approx +14% token-storage cost).
- Forensic hold: we support administrative holds that pin snapshots and prevent purge. For holds >120 days we require DPA amendment and we notify subprocessor teams; beyond 180 days we'd need Legal engagement.
- Encryption: CMK support is available on Dedicated; on Hosted we can offer envelope encryption with customer-supplied keys for certain customers but it requires an account-level activation step and an additional KMS integration lead time (2–3 weeks).

Risks/notes:
- Monthly 3-day rolling purge is low-risk but does require an explicit restore-runbook for customers who need immediate recovery within the window.
- We need to capture the requirement for exportability (customer data export in interoperable format) in the DPA addendum.

I can join the alignment call. Marissa — please draft the addendum language for the audit log extension, forensic hold ceiling, CMK options, and export commitments.

— Kimberly
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@medipath.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medipath.com
Date: 2028-07-02T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention schedule alignment for Medipath

Thanks Logan/Kimberly — good start. A few clarifications and asks:

- Medipath requests audit/security logs be retained for 18 months due to audit requirements; we are willing to accept the +14% uplift if you can document the cost in the SOW.
- Forensic holds: we need a ceiling of 180 days for incident-driven holds as a minimum; please include explicit language about the hold-release workflow and notification timelines.
- Exportability: backups and logs must be exportable in JSON/CSV for logs and Parquet/NDJSON for bulk data.
- Encryption: we need CMK support on Day 1 of Dedicated, and if you intend to use envelope keys on hosted, that must be documented including the key rotation policy.

Procurement notes: our legal team will circulate a DPA addendum request — I attached the initial doc with Medipath comments. We have a target to get DPA and SOW signed by Aug 7 to hit the mid-August go-live.

Thanks,
Sarah

Attachment: DPA_addendum_request.docx (Word)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@medipath.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention schedule alignment for Medipath — next steps and MAP

Sarah — appreciate the specificity. Short confirmation and mutual action plan (MAP) below.

Confirmed items:
- We will offer audit/security log retention at 18 months for Medipath under DEAL-8342 with a documented cost uplift; Marissa will include the line item in the SOW.
- Forensic hold ceiling: Redwood will accept incident-driven holds up to 180 days with Legal notification; language will be added to the DPA addendum.
- Exportability: we will provide exported formats (JSON/CSV for logs; Parquet/NDJSON for bulk exports).
- CMK: CMK support on Dedicated is confirmed for Day 1. Host-side envelope-key options will be provided and documented for hosted should you request them, but CMK on Hosted is not available at launch.

Action plan and owners:
1) Marissa Cole: Draft DPA addendum and updated SOW with cost uplift and exportability language. Deliver by 2028-07-06.
2) Kimberly Park: Finalize technical annex (encryption, purge runbook, restore SLA) and confirm KMS integration steps. Deliver by 2028-07-05.
3) Logan Wright: Schedule a 30-minute alignment call (proposed 2028-07-06 11:00 AM PT) and circulate MAP.

I've attached the MAP PDF for signatures and I'll queue Legal to review the DPA changes once Marissa posts the draft. If those deliverable dates work, we'll aim to get DocuSign executed by Aug 4 to leave a short runway before the Aug 15 purge.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

— Logan
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_Medipath_8342.pdf (PDF)
